llm.summary: This is a local browser note board that stores user-entered notes and chosen files locally, with no evidence of hidden network access or deceptive behavior.

dimensions.detail: Clipboard paste, drag-and-drop files, downloads, localStorage, and IndexedDB are proportionate to the stated local note collection and export purpose, and I found no fetch, websocket, beacon, service worker, or remote script behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs users to open or distribute the included HTML file, with optional packaging through a skill-creator script; no install-time executable script is included in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation wording is broader than ideal, including a generic HTML-to-skill packaging phrase and no explicit non-goals, but the runtime instructions remain tied to the local note-board workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: User notes, images, and selected file blobs persist in browser localStorage and IndexedDB as disclosed; deletion and clearing actions are user-directed and scoped to the app's own stored data.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The advertised purpose is a single-file local note, image, folder, and Word-export tool; the inspected HTML implements those features with browser APIs and no external dependencies.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a local browser-based note board. Be aware that pasted notes, images, and selected files remain in that browser's local storage until you clear them, so avoid storing sensitive material on shared machines.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger and generic packaging language could cause over-invocation for adjacent tasks, but it does not create hidden authority or unsafe behavior in the artifact.
[SQP-1] expected: The positive use examples match the local note-board and docx-export purpose; the lack of negative examples is a documentation precision issue rather than a security concern requiring Review.
